plaatsen.tekst: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
And though I bestow ➔ all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
